task: Four-context population log2-fold-change transfer, without held-out basal expression
panels: Annotation intersection of all available outcome-gene and target labels; report archive preprocessing and unsupported labels separately
split: Leave one whole context out; hyperparameters selected with inner leave-one-training-context-out folds
scale: Author-published log2FoldChange; preserve input values without renormalization; do not infer the estimator from a column name
global_template: Per gene: finite mean over common targets within each training context, then equal mean of available context means. Zero fallback only if all contexts missing that gene.
heterogeneity_shrink: For each target/gene finite count n_j and mean mu_j. J={genes:n_j>=2}; M=mean_J(mu_j^2), q=mean_J(sample_variance_j/n_j); alpha=max(1-lambda*q/M,0). J empty -> unshrunk mean with undefined disagreement, ranked last; M=0 -> zero prediction. Apply target alpha to every supported coordinate. Conventional heuristic, not calibrated uncertainty. Penalty0 always returns unshrunk mean, including sparse M0 cases; the M0 zero rule applies only to positive penalties.
tuning: Choose lowest equal-context mean target-MSE; exact numerical ties choose smallest alpha for global shrink or largest lambda for heterogeneity shrink
nonfinite_rule: Infinity fails. NaN stays missing. Per-coordinate source mean uses finite sources; no-source prediction is explicit zero-effect fallback, never truth imputation. Score only finite outer truth with the same target-specific gene mask for every model. Unscorable targets remain in counts.
negative_control: Independently permute target identities within each training context using seeded permutations; held-out truth unchanged. Pure context-label permutation is inert for these symmetric predictors.
risk_ranking: absolute training disagreement V=mean_J sample variance
relative disagreement V/(M+V), all-zero denominator=1; undefined ranks last
mean of50 random rankings with seed20260911
risk_curves: Fractions0.1,...,1.0 with exact target identities and every model scored on each identical retained set, including zero and global_shrink. Undefined disagreement targets rank last. Risk is conditional on finite author truth.
primary: Target macro-MSE over every common outcome gene, reported per context and equally across contexts
secondary: cosine direction similarity with zero norms explicitly undefined
prospective_advantage_gate: At least10% MSE improvement over the strongest eligible conventional comparator in at least3/4 outer contexts, no worse overall; engineering gate not significance. Negative findings remain results.
scope_limits: Four selected cell lines and distinct protocols
No individual-cell prediction or raw-count generation
No held-out context features; cannot identify target-context-specific directions
Known effects already estimated using each archive's original experimental controls and DE pipeline
Dataset gene filtering precedes this study and may reflect perturbed outcomes
No future modification of grids in response to outer results without a new labeled development study
revision_reason: Independent pre-fit synthetic review: preserve exact lambda0=unshrunk mean for sparse M0 case; make template context weighting explicit. No model fitting or scores inspected.
